permissionDescriptions.control_console: Allows sending commands to the server through the console.
permissionDescriptions.control_start: Allows starting the server when it is stopped.
permissionDescriptions.control_stop: Allows stopping the server while it is running.
permissionDescriptions.control_restart: Allows restarting the server, including starting it when offline.
permissionDescriptions.user_read: Allows viewing server subusers and their permissions.
permissionDescriptions.user_delete: Allows removing a subuser from the server.
permissionDescriptions.file_create: Allows creating files and folders through the panel or upload.
permissionDescriptions.file_read: Allows listing directory contents, but not reading or downloading files.
permissionDescriptions.file_read_content: Allows reading and downloading file contents.
permissionDescriptions.file_update: Allows modifying existing files and directories.
permissionDescriptions.file_archive: Allows creating archives and extracting existing archives.
permissionDescriptions.file_sftp: Allows connecting over SFTP and managing files with the assigned file permissions.
permissionDescriptions.plugin_read: Allows viewing the plugin catalog and installed plugins.
permissionDescriptions.plugin_download: Allows installing verified plugins; file-create permission is also required.
permissionDescriptions.backup_download: Allows downloading backups, including all server files contained in them.
permissionDescriptions.backup_restore: Allows restoring backups, which may delete all current server files.
permissionDescriptions.allocation_read: Allows viewing server allocations. The primary allocation is always visible to server users.
permissionDescriptions.allocation_create: Allows assigning additional allocations to the server.
permissionDescriptions.allocation_update: Allows changing the primary allocation and editing allocation notes.
permissionDescriptions.allocation_delete: Allows removing an allocation from the server.
permissionDescriptions.startup_docker_image: Allows changing the Docker image used to run the server.
permissionDescriptions.database_create: Allows creating a database for the server.
permissionDescriptions.database_update: Allows rotating a database password. Viewing the new password requires the view-password permission.
permissionDescriptions.database_delete: Allows removing a database from the server.
permissionDescriptions.database_view_password: Allows viewing a server database password.
permissionDescriptions.schedule_read: Allows viewing schedules and their tasks.
permissionDescriptions.schedule_update: Allows modifying schedules and scheduled tasks.
permissionDescriptions.settings_rename: Allows renaming the server and changing its description.

welcome.title: Welcome to SynoraDesk
welcome.subtitle: Modern open-source desktop client for Pterodactyl Panel
welcome.tagline: Centralized server management, blazing performance, and zero sensitive data collection
welcome.featPanelsDesc: Connect unlimited Pterodactyl Panels simultaneously with safe Client API & Application API auth.
welcome.featToolsDesc: Integrated drag-and-drop SFTP Explorer, Monaco Code Editor, MySQL/PostgreSQL Database Manager and real-time Console.
welcome.featSecurityDesc: Secured by Windows Data Protection API (DPAPI) + AES-256-GCM, plus App Lock with PIN or Passcode.
welcome.termsTitle: Terms of Service & Data Privacy Commitment
welcome.termsP1: SynoraDesk is built entirely non-profit and open-source. We strictly respect your privacy and complete ownership of your data.
welcome.termsCommitmentHeading: Commitment NOT to collect sensitive data:
welcome.termsCommitment1: Zero external storage of API keys, passwords, database credentials, or tokens outside your personal computer.
welcome.termsCommitment2: All connection info and settings are locally encrypted with Windows DPAPI and stored in local SQLite.
welcome.termsCommitment3: No user data transmission, no telemetry tracking, zero analytics and zero third-party ads.
welcome.termsCommitment4: All network traffic occurs directly between your client and the Pterodactyl Panel host you configure.
welcome.checkboxLabel: I have read, understood, and agree to SynoraDesk's Terms of Service and Data Privacy Commitment.
welcome.resetConfirmDesc: This action will permanently delete all panel profiles, configurations, local SQLite database, and DPAPI encryption keys on this machine. Are you sure you want to proceed?
